coverage_note: Initial 50-record prototype batch concentrated in Utawala and adjacent Eastlands localities. Expand geographically before treating as representative of Nairobi Eastlands.

guardrails.availability: A live/public listing is not proof that the unit remains vacant. Reverify before presenting as confirmed available.
guardrails.descriptions: Do not republish full advertiser prose. This file uses normalized factual fields and generated summaries.
guardrails.images: Image URLs remain hosted by the source. Use for internal/prototype evaluation; do not mirror or claim ownership without permission/licensing.
guardrails.source_attribution: Every record retains its source URL and source name.
guardrails.personal_data: No seller phone numbers or private contact details are included.
guardrails.quality: Do not silently correct suspicious source values; flag them and recheck the original listing.
guardrails.duplicates: Deduplicate using source listing ID and source URL before ingesting future batches.
guardrails.staleness: Recheck listing status before user-facing display and expire stale records.
guardrails.category_filter: Exclude for-sale, commercial-only, already-let, or unrelated records from long-term residential search.
guardrails.short_stay: Keep short-let/Airbnb inventory in a separate category from monthly residential rentals.

data_dictionary.listing_id: Identifier taken from the source listing URL.
data_dictionary.evidence_level: detail_page_verified means the individual listing page was resolved/opened during collection.
data_dictionary.availability_status: Advert currently listed; physical vacancy not independently confirmed.
data_dictionary.image_urls: Array of source-hosted image references captured for the prototype.
data_dictionary.source_description: Original full source description; deliberately omitted here.
data_dictionary.generated_summary: Short original summary created from normalized fields.
data_dictionary.content_rights: How source-derived content is treated in this prototype.
data_dictionary.data_quality_flags: Warnings where a packaged field is unconfirmed or requires rechecking.
